_comment: UNVERIFIED AFTER RENAME (2026-08-07). Product 9PLRSZZMFPJH was reserved as 'Hearth'; its Partner Center package identity was ToledoTechnologies.Hearth. The Hearth->Ample sweep rewrote this file automatically, so identityName below is a PLACEHOLDER, not an observed value. Partner Center assigns Package/Identity/Name from the reserved name - it is not author-chosen. Before any candidate build: reserve 'Ample' in Partner Center, read the assigned identity off the product's Identity page, and paste the exact value here. A package whose identity does not match the reservation will be rejected at submission.
